'''Saven 9 (May 19)'''

==Events==
</noinclude>
*{{ne|999}} - [[Elayne]], [[Egwene]], and [[Nynaeve]] are captured by the [[Black Ajah]] and kept in the [[Stone of Tear]]. Egwene then incapacitates [[Joiya Byir]] and [[Amico Nagoyin]] in ''[[Tel'aran'rhiod]]''.
*{{ne|999}} - [[Faile]] falls into a ''[[ter'angreal]]'' trap set by the Black Ajah. [[Perrin]] enters ''[[Tel'aran'rhiod]]'' to save her.
*{{ne|999}} - [[Mat]], [[Juilin]], and the [[Aiel]] infiltrate the Stone of Tear and begin battle.
*{{ne|999}} - [[Moiraine]] kills [[Be'lal]] with [[balefire]].
*{{ne|999}} - [[Rand]] takes ''[[Callandor]]'' from the Heart of the Stone, later declaring himself the [[Dragon Reborn]].
*{{ne|999}} - Rand pursues and kills [[Ishamael|Ba'alzamon]].
